pub13.title: Install RightOne Player
pub13.step.enrol.1: Open the premises portal and choose Devices.
pub13.step.enrol.2: Choose Add a device and name it, for example Bar counter.
pub13.step.enrol.3: Note the 12-character pairing code shown on screen.
pub13.step.pair.1: Open RightOne Player on the device.
pub13.step.pair.2: Enter the pairing code in three groups of four characters.
pub13.step.pair.3: Check the premises name shown on the device, then choose Confirm.
pub13.step.sync.1: Keep the device online while it loads the playlists for the first time.
pub13.step.sync.2: Offline, the device keeps playing and sends the playback evidence at the next connection.
pub13.step.recover.1: Switch the device off and on again.
pub13.step.recover.2: If it still shows a fault, open the premises portal, choose the device and choose Report a fault.
pub13.step.recover.3: Call the support line if the device has not resumed after 30 minutes.
